definitions.raw_emit_fraction: raw emit-positive completions / all completed NN updates in each disjoint retirement phase
definitions.k2_fraction_of_emit: raw K=2 completions / raw emit-positive completions; positive K is produced only on emit by this runtime
definitions.slot0_current_fraction: engine-generated slot0 current-line addresses / all decoded slot0 addresses; selected raw and payload outputs are identical
definitions.slot1_plus2_fraction: raw slot1 predicted cache-line delta +2 / all decoded slot1 addresses
definitions.current_credit_fraction: actual allowed current-line cache calls / all actual allowed calls, at the common ceiling; distinct from generated fraction
definitions.scope: Frozen balanced checkpoints, zero-cost NN; two full future ROIs. No prefix extrapolation, averaged seed replacement, causal per-request claim, or minimum-observation threshold. Undefined denominators leave gaps.
